QuestInfo.name: Request of the Test Subject 1
QuestInfo.0: #p2151005# hesitates to ask you something. Talk to #b#p2151005##k at the Underground Base.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151005# says she'd like to use her knowledge of medicine to help the Resistance, but she's unsure whether her knowledge is accurate or not. To confirm, she wants to try concocting the medicine. Head over to #b#m310030110##k and find the ingredients for her experiment.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered #t4000600# items to #p2151005#. She said she can make sure the medicine is effective now...

0.0: I may not be able to do much, but I can make medicine! I learned a lot by watching the Black Wings while I was locked up. Nothing else to do, really... \r\n#L0##bMembers of the Resistance are constantly injured in battle. I think your contribution will be a great help.#l\n#k
0.1: You...you really think so? But I'm not so sure... I learned by watching the Black Wings, but I don't know what they were making! What if I end up making something that's harmful? \r\n#L0##bWell, you won't know until you try, right? Go ahead and give it a shot!#l\n#k
0.2: Yes. You're right! I shouldn't worry when I haven't even made the medicine yet, right? So, would you help me? I don't really have anyone else to ask...

yes.0: From what I could tell, the medicine contained #t4000600#s. Can you hunt #r#o1150002#s#k and bring me #b15 #t4000600#s#k? I hope I'm not asking too much...
yes.1: I hear #o1150002#s live somewhere nearby. Maybe you can find #b#m310030110##k near the Strolling Path?

no.0: Oh, I see. I'm sorry. I'm sure you're busy and... I'm sure I can find someone else. Sorry.

1.0: Thank you so much! You're really strong! I didn't need to fret about you. How silly of me. Hehe... I'll go make the medicine now! Just a minute!

item.0: Oh, you haven't found #b15 #t4000600#s#k yet? You should head over to #b#m310030110##k... But no rush. It's not urgent.
